# Third-party policy

POSTMAN keeps upstream projects as pinned dependencies or external assets. It
does not copy whole upstream repositories into the core package. Every vendored
asset must include its source URL, revision, license, and NOTICE entry.

The v1 allowlist is Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, and MIT. GPL,
AGPL, and non-commercial/share-alike assets stay outside the core distribution.
